text: Been using this app for over 6 years and it has CHANGED MY LIFE. Focus, relaxation, it helps me a lot. This combined with noise cancelling headphones sees me work and focus and relax even in noisy environments.

Ik werk er nu een jaar mee en zet vaak de focus modus aan tijdens werk en de chill modus in de auto. Hierdoor ben ik minder snel overprikkeld, onderprikkelt of moe. Door brain.fm kan ik vol energie werken aan iedere marketing opdracht, een boek lezen of nog even een avondje doorwerken.

text: As a person with AD(h)D, the first time I tried brainmf felt like I was in a small boat on a big river of thoughts and intentions. For the first in a long time, I actually had paddles to help steer my boat. I do feel I need to add this is not a typical day experience. I use brainfm alongside my ad(h)d medication, a pomodoro app, and airplain mode on my phone. It is not a cure, for ADD, but for me the 'deep focus' mode is helping me. Why not sign up for a free trial and try it yourself?
author: Desiree Primrose
